name: project-cmd-e2e-local-rel-table-roster
body: `merge_spec_only_lands_authored_rows_in_main_db` carries a test-local kind-to-rel-table roster covering the 15 durable authored edge kinds, duplicating production's private `DURABLE_EDGE_TABLES` (src/artifacts/db.rs) because no public accessor exists; it panics on an unknown kind, so a new authored edge kind fails loudly rather than silently skipping a row. Upgrade to a crate-visible roster accessor if that roster becomes queryable or shared, rather than refactoring only for this test.
